statements.status_notes: Upstream stunnel 5.80 caps log message formatting in s_vlog with a fixed 1024-byte buffer, preventing the stack out-of-bounds read on oversized protocol log lines. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-70368 and https://www.stunnel.org/CVE-2026-70368.html

Upstream stunnel 5.80 tightens SOCKS server destination filtering to reject unspecified addresses, IPv4-mapped IPv6 loopback encodings, and interface-scoped IPv6 targets. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-70367 and https://www.stunnel.org/CVE-2026-70367.html
